note: Provisional defaults for the chunk_cache shadow plan, measured on Qwen3-4B (F32 K/V) on one AMD Strix Halo box. Calibrated per model and kernel later; a prediction, never a promise.

vulkan.source: G2 (ATTN_QPOS selective recompute: 13-19 us per recomputed row x visible key, whole forward); G1 (device-copy assembly ~70,000 tok/s; full prefill ~10x the CPU)

cpu.source: E1 (CPU chunk encode / prefill ~140 tok/s, host assembly ~9,000 tok/s); per row-key cost derived from one ~7 ms row forward at ~8K visible keys
